title: WA Recovery Pro v1.9.4 — Real Voice Audio Sharing & 1-Prompt Video Recording
changelog: 🔊 Real Voice Sharing: Recorded voice notes are now saved to Music/WARecovery and shared as real .m4a audio files with full sound
🎥 1-Prompt Video Recording: MediaProjection token is reused automatically, share screen prompt appears only once per session
📤 Real Audio Export: Export button now shares the actual audio file instead of a dummy placeholder
🎙️ Correct Path Resolution: All share/forward/export functions resolve filePath > voicePath > audioUrl chain
